About Plug And Play

 What You Will Do

 • Thesis & Market Intelligence
• Develop and refine investment roadmaps in Enterprise & AI.
• Track industry trends, regulatory shifts, and competitive landscapes.
• Identify and profile the most promising startups and technologies in target markets.
• Company & Ecosystem Tracking
• Monitor performance of notable startups, scaleups, and major industry players.
• Track venture investment activity, acquisitions, and partnership trends.
• Maintain internal knowledge bases and market maps to guide sourcing and decision-making.
• Enterprise-Driven Insights
• Gather intelligence directly from our enterprise ecosystem through interviews, surveys, and feedback loops.
• Translate enterprise perspectives into reports and buyer-driven insights that inform investment theses and help startups understand customer needs. 
• Support Investment Process
• Contribute to company diligence: product analysis, technical reviews, market sizing, customer references.
• Summarize research into clear, data-driven insights for the Ventures team and Enterprises.

• Partner with senior team members to align Enterprise needs with startup opportunities.
• Support occasional events, founder introductions, and content initiatives — with research at the core of your contributions.
• Collaborate with the Plug and Play team to understand corporate innovation needs and facilitate targeted introductions between startups and corporate partners
• Manage dealflow sessions, ensuring relevant startups are presented effectively to corporate partners

 About You

 • Analytical & Technical: Degree (or self-taught expertise) in computer science, data science, engineering, mathematics, or related field. Able to evaluate technical products and trends.
• Research-Oriented: You love deep dives, connecting dots, and building structured insights from fragmented information.
• Ecosystem Connector: Comfortable engaging with executives to extract insights, run surveys, and capture the “voice of the buyer” to enrich your research.
• Content Creator: Skilled at writing clear, engaging, and professional content — from research reports to blog posts and public-facing insights.
• Strong Communicator: Clear, concise writer and presenter; able to tailor insights to investors, executives, and founders.
• Curious & Proactive: You thrive on learning new technologies, experimenting with AI tools, and staying on the cutting edge.
• Experience: 2–3 years in VC, consulting, banking, product, research, or a technical role — or exceptional projects that prove your ability.
• Entrepreneurial Mindset: Independent thinker, fast learner, and self-starter who thrives in a dynamic, venture environment.
